body.name: fully specified three-block randomized-interval program
body.construction: In \(\mathcal E_3\), let \(n_1=n_2=n_3=1\), \(W=\{2\}\), \(q_2=1\), \(A_1=A_3=\{z_0\}\), and \(A_2=\{z_0,z_1\}\). Assign \(z_0\) with probability one in blocks \(1\) and \(3\), and assign each arm with probability \(1/2\) in block \(2\) for every possible history. The available potential outcomes lie in \(\{-M,0,M\}\), and schedules obey \(|Y_{21}(z_0)-Y_{11}(z_0)|+|Y_{31}(z_0)-Y_{21}(z_0)|\le\gamma\). The observed record is \((Y_{11}(z_0),Z_{21},Y_{21}(Z_{21}),Y_{31}(z_0))\). Actions are all closed intervals with endpoints in \(\{-2M,-M,0,M,2M\}\), randomized by \(U_{\mathrm{aux}}\). LP variables give the action probabilities at each observed record; one coverage constraint is imposed for every admissible schedule, probabilities sum to one at each record, and a scalar objective bounds expected length for every schedule.
